APP_ACCESS_KEY.description: Half of the signing pair. The names come from 100ms's own sample backend and are unusually generic for a shared file, so expect to rename them if another service claims the same.

APP_SECRET.description: 100ms says this ensures the workspace secret is not exposed to the client side, and that the management token must not be exposed there either. The browser receives a generated auth token, or a narrower room code.
